name: Misa
message: 「As you can see, everything's perfect over here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, just doing some patrols of the other areas and stuff.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't leave your post too much, okay?」

name: Ria
message: 「Preparations over at the tower are pretty much done~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Looks like things are going fine here too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Seems like the Holy Night Festival is going to go well.」

name: Helena
message: 「It's wonderful that the Holy Night Festival looks like it'll be lovely, but you haven't forgotten the other matter, have you?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Re-Crea, right! There's no way I'd forget!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's left to worry about is what that bastard Bylous is up to, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Has there been any word from Melphas?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Talk about useless when it actually counts.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So this is what they call impotence!」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like we have no choice but to handle this on our own.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh! The President is totally ready to do it!」

name: Helena
message: 「Right now, Melilot has tightened security inside the academy.」

name: Helena
message: 「If anything happens, she should let us know right away.」

name: Helena
message: 「Members of the Student Council... no, the Crusaders!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Somehow, I'm starting to get nervous...」

name: Macaron
message: 「What are you saying, pull yourself together!」

name: Paqy
message: 「The fate of the world is resting on the Demon Lord's shoulders, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「If we don't do our best, everyone's going to lose what's precious to them.」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Azel is really serious about this, isn't she.」

name: Synn
message: 「Back then... Azel said it was the will of God.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, we haven't actually heard how Azel herself feels yet.」

name: Synn
message: 「We have to find out what Azel really wants to do.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Do you think we can persuade her?」

name: Synn
message: 「First, I plan to try doing that.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then it's time for a super harsh punishment, right!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll make her properly reflect on all the trouble she caused everyone...」

name: Synn
message: 「And then next time, I'll have her properly get along with everyone.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I doubt that jerk Aze is gonna play nice so easily, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「If we enjoy the Holy Night Festival together, I'm sure she'll open up.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah! I personally guarantee how fun festivals in the Human World are!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure that's our duty as Demon Lords.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Intending to bring everything under your domination--that's our Demon Lord for ya!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Domination doesn't suit you at all, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, if I had to say, how about being dominated by me?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not that much of an M, you know.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, what kind of stupid thing are you saying!」

name: Macaron
message: 「If you mess around too much, I... won't give you a present!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well... today's a special day, isn't it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I told you, I wanted to give a present to someone special...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez! I'm the one giving you a present, so of course you should be happy!」
What Macaron pulled out from inside her coat was an apron with a cool, cynical design.

name: Macaron
message: 「H-Hehehe... I made it by hand, so of course it's good.」

name: Macaron
message: 「By the way, mine's a Kopinkuma apron.」

name: Synn
message: 「That means we can cook together anytime now!」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's no big deal, I can make as many of these as you want...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, is there nothing for yours truly?」

name: Synn
message: 「There's something I want to show you, Macaron, so...」
Taking Macaron's hand, heading toward the destination.

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on. I'll flip the switch right now.」
The illuminations flash on, and a glittering fountain emerges from the courtyard that had been sunk in indigo darkness.
Just stringing together tree ornaments to float on the water and wrapping fairy lights around the perimeter.
And then, a tiny bit of abusing my authority. Borrowing the power supply meant for the Holy Night Festival, things like that.

name: Synn
message: 「I figured a regular Christmas tree would be boring, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「It was a spur-of-the-moment thing, but I decorated this just for you, Macaron.」

name: Synn
message: 「Guess my DIY skills actually came in handy.」
If I do say so myself, it turned out pretty impressive.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it's Macaron's very first Christmas, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I just wanted it to be a memorable experience for her, even a little.」

name: Macaron
message: 「You can be weirdly cheesy sometimes, Big Brother!」
Macaron throws her arms around my neck and leaps at me.
All the exhaustion from preparing, and all the anxiety about Re-Crea, gets completely blown away.

name: Synn
message: 「You worked a part-time job to buy the materials and tools for the apron too, didn't you, Macaron?」

name: Macaron
message: 「T-That was only because I didn't have anything to spend my leftover pay on anyway...」

name: Macaron
message: 「And I was thinking of buying a cake with it, which turned out to be unnecessary...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Plus, well, I kinda had other reasons too, I guess...」

name: Synn
message: 「There you go again, you're terrible at hiding your embarrassment.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Go fall in the fountain, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Whose fault do you think it is that I got all embarrassed in the first place!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, still getting along great as usual, good for you.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I made a cool bib for you too, Paqy-sama.」

name: Paqy
message: 「W-What the hell, you actually got one for me...」

name: Macaron
message: 「It'll totally look great on you! Here you go♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Still, should I even be happy about this...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, anyway, I'm just glad you liked it, Macaron.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, I'll never forget a weird present like this!」
The two of us look up together at the fountain tree.
Our gaze continues upward, toward the trails of shining stars in the night sky.

name: Synn
message: 「We're going to put an end to Re-Crea with our own hands.」
Our clasped hands tighten their grip.
The warmth passing between us was reassuring.

name: Melilot
message: 「...So this is where you two were.」

name: Melilot
message: 「For you, Sakura-kun, that was quite a flashy prank, wasn't it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, it's fine. Well, it's not a big issue.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, big sis Melilot. Could it be...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. Everyone is gathering at Finis Tower as well.」

name: Melilot
message: 「So that man has shown up as well.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, a three-way standoff... I don't like this.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. Bylous is only after me, after all.」

name: Macaron
message: 「If Bylous's goal is the Demon Lord, then I'm fighting too!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, my pride won't let me leave things at a loss!」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're not going to say it's too dangerous... not now, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「We're the Demon Lord together, after all.」

name: Bylous
message: 「I have waited long for this, Demon Lord.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's turned into one hell of a weird standoff, hasn't it...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's nothing we can do on our own, y'know.」

name: Ria
message: 「It looks like both of them were waiting for Synn and Macaron, though...」

name: Azel
message: 「What are you saying at this late hour?」

name: Azel
message: 「My Lord's will is absolute. Defiance is unforgivable.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you really okay with that, Azel?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Never mind some god--how do you truly feel, Azel?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san, let's put an end to doing things that make everyone sad!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「This world is full of fun things and precious things, you know!」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm telling you, I don't have anything like that...」

name: Ria
message: 「Then let's start making them together with everyone!」

name: Misa
message: 「Just doing whatever God tells you can't be called your own will, Azel-san!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nothing's gonna start if you just keep running away!」

name: Azel
message: 「This is the only thing I can do...」

name: Azel
message: 「As I am now, I can no longer defy the power of Re-Crea...」

name: Synn
message: 「We can drive the power of Re-Crea out of Azel... right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...With the Demon Lord's power, theoretically, yes.」

name: Melilot
message: 「In the end, however, it depends on how you all handle yourselves.」

name: Bylous
message: 「That's right. Demon Lord, show me your power.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Your power that can defeat and surpass even Re-Crea...」

name: Bylous
message: 「Once you have surpassed the power of Re-Crea, I shall request another bout with you...」

name: Helena
message: 「Really, this girl--just who do you think you're talking to!」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you get carried away, you'll get hurt.」

name: Riesling
message: 「There are no oversights on our end.」

name: Pasta
message: 「...Pasta will lend a paw too, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「To Master Bylous... and to you guys too...」

name: Pasta
message: 「This is the last time Pasta will ever lend you strength, nya.」

name: Synn
message: 「We're coming at you with everything we've got, Azel!」
